home.modules_empty: No modules are enabled for this account yet. The platform team enables them when your account is set up.
home.settings_card_body: The rules for orders, delivery and cash on delivery on this account.

account.description: The rules for taking in orders, delivery and cash on delivery on this account. Each section saves on its own.
account.read_only: You can view these settings only; the account owner or an admin changes them.
account.limits_description: The platform team sets these limits when it sets up the account.

intake.title: Order intake
intake.receive_as_pending: It waits until your team accepts it
intake.receive_as_pending_hint: New orders are reviewed before they reach dispatch.
intake.auto_accept_hint: New orders go straight to dispatch.
intake.max_attempts_hint: From 1 to 10 attempts before the order is returned.

proof.title: Proof of delivery
proof.hint: What the driver collects before the delivery closes.

reason_codes.title: Reason codes
reason_codes.description: The reasons a driver picks when a delivery fails, in Arabic and English. Up to 100 reasons.
reason_codes.code_hint: Lowercase English letters, digits and underscores, 2 to 40 characters.
reason_codes.label: Label
reason_codes.limit: You have reached the limit of 100 reasons.

dispatch.title: Auto-dispatch
dispatch.enabled_hint: Each ready order is offered to available drivers in waves.

security.title: Security
security.second_factor: Require a second factor from every member
security.second_factor_hint: Members who enrolled a phone are always asked for a code. When this is on, the others enrol a phone at their next sign-in.

drivers.title: Driver app
drivers.offline_window_hint: From 1 to 48 hours after a run ends during which the app accepts what the driver recorded offline.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.receipt_tolerance_hint: The difference between ordered and received quantity accepted without review.
warehouse.adjustment_threshold_hint: An adjustment above this quantity needs a second person's approval.

members.description: The people who work on this account, their roles and the sites they work at.
members.empty_hint: Invite the people who run deliveries, sites and cash with you.

invite_dialog.title: Invite a member
invite_dialog.description: We email a link to set a password. The link is valid for 72 hours.
invite_dialog.name: Name
invite_dialog.sites_hint: Site staff, warehouse staff and cashiers work only at the sites ticked here; the other roles see every site.
invite_dialog.no_sites: This account has no sites yet.

detail.invitation_banner: The invitation was sent to {email}. It is waiting to be accepted.
detail.revoked_banner: This membership is revoked. It comes back only through a new invitation.
detail.access_description: A change signs the member out; the new access applies at their next sign-in.
detail.driver_kept: The driver role is managed with the drivers and stays as it is.

locks.self: You cannot change your own membership.
locks.owner_only: Only an owner can change an owner's membership.
locks.owner_grant: Only an owner can grant or remove the owner role.
locks.last_owner: This is the account's only owner; the owner role stays.

revoke.title: Revoke {name}'s access?
revoke.consequence_sessions: They are signed out everywhere within a few minutes and can no longer open this account.
revoke.consequence_audit: What they did stays in the audit log.
revoke.consequence_return: They come back only through a new invitation.
revoke.withdraw_consequence: The link in the email stops working.

reset.title: Reset {name}'s second factor?
reset.description: For a member who lost the phone they enrolled.
reset.consequence_phone: The enrolled phone is removed and they are signed out everywhere.
reset.consequence_link: They get an email with a link to enrol a phone again; the password alone cannot enrol.
reset.reason_hint: From 5 to 500 characters. Kept in the audit log.
reset.done: Second factor reset. The member gets an email with a link to enrol again.

sites.description: The branches and warehouses of this account: their names, address, location and opening hours.

kind_hints.branch: Dispatches orders to drivers and holds their cash.
kind_hints.warehouse: Holds stock: receiving, storage and packing.
kind_hints.both: Does both from the same address.

sites.empty_hint: Add the branches and warehouses your team works from.
sites.new_description: A branch dispatches orders, a warehouse holds stock. You can change the details later.

form.names_hint: In Arabic and English, up to 120 characters each.
form.short_code_hint: Four letters and four digits, for example RRRD2929.
form.location_hint: Copy the coordinates of the short code from the National Address, with up to 5 decimals. A map arrives in a later release.
form.hours_hint: Times in 24-hour HH:MM, for example 09:00. A closing time before the opening time runs past midnight.

state.title: Status
state.inactive_banner: This site is inactive: it takes no new work. Activate it to use it again.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.consequence_work: It takes no new orders, cash or stock.
deactivate.consequence_keep: Its history stays, and you can activate it again at any time.
deactivate.in_use: The site is still in use:

activate.title: Activate {name}?
activate.consequence: It takes new work again and counts toward the account's site limit.

sites.limit_reached: Your account has reached its limit of {limit} active sites. Deactivate a site or ask the platform team for a higher limit.

in_use_reasons.open_orders: Orders that are not finished yet
in_use_reasons.unsettled_cash: Cash that is not settled yet
